subsystems.name: Fuel cycle
subsystems.role: supplies and recycles the hydrogen isotopes that fuse.

subsystems.name: Confinement system
subsystems.role: holds the fusing plasma together long enough at high enough density — by magnetic fields (tokamak, stellarator) or by inertial compression (laser or pulsed power).

subsystems.name: Heating and current drive
subsystems.role: pushes the plasma past the temperature and pressure needed for fusion.

subsystems.name: Blanket and first wall
subsystems.role: faces the plasma, slows the fusion neutrons and captures their energy as heat while breeding tritium.

subsystems.name: Exhaust
subsystems.role: removes helium 'ash' and waste heat without eroding the wall.

subsystems.name: Power conversion
subsystems.role: turns blanket heat into steam or another working fluid and then electricity — a stage no fusion device has reached.

buildSteps.title: Choose the confinement route
buildSteps.detail: Magnetic confinement shapes a low-density plasma held for seconds to minutes; inertial confinement compresses a tiny fuel capsule in nanoseconds. Each dictates the whole plant.

buildSteps.title: Build the reaction chamber
buildSteps.detail: A vacuum vessel (or target chamber) is fabricated to tight tolerances and lined with materials chosen to survive neutron bombardment.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the drive system
buildSteps.detail: Either superconducting magnet coils are wound and cooled to near absolute zero, or banks of lasers or pulsed-power drivers are aligned onto the target.

buildSteps.title: Add heating, fuelling and instruments
buildSteps.detail: Beams, antennas and gas or pellet injectors are fitted, along with diagnostics that watch the plasma in real time.

buildSteps.title: Wrap the chamber in a breeding blanket
buildSteps.detail: Lithium-containing modules are installed around the vessel so the escaping neutrons create fresh tritium and deposit heat.

buildSteps.title: Close the fuel loop
buildSteps.detail: A tritium plant extracts bred tritium, purifies it and feeds it back — tritium is radioactive and leaks easily, so this is a sealed, remote-handled system.

buildSteps.title: Run with deuterium and tritium
buildSteps.detail: The plant must first prove it can operate and be maintained without contaminating or losing its fuel.

buildSteps.title: Convert heat to electricity
buildSteps.detail: Blanket coolant drives a turbine and generator feeding the grid, while the plant handles its own radioactive waste and tritium inventory.

prerequisites.why: a laser experiment reached ignition in 2022, but no magnetic device has yet produced more fusion energy than it absorbs.
tritium is scarce and decays quickly; a power plant must manufacture its own fuel inside the blanket.
the neutron flux damages and activates structural materials far faster than in fission plants.
high-temperature superconductor coils demonstrated around 20 tesla in 2021 could shrink machines, but they are not yet proven at plant scale.

prerequisites.tech: Steady, controlled operation and remote maintenance
prerequisites.why: a power plant must run reliably for long pulses and be repaired by robots because the interior is radioactive.

pathway.milestone: large experiments such as ITER in France under construction, and a wave of privately funded compact designs
pathway.unlocks: data on plasma behaviour, materials and tritium handling at reactor scale.

pathway.milestone: devices that demonstrate burning plasma and substantial net gain
pathway.unlocks: confidence that a fusion core can power itself and a plant can be designed around it.

pathway.milestone: a pilot plant that generates electricity and breeds its own tritium
pathway.unlocks: integration of blanket, fuel cycle and power conversion.
firm, low-carbon baseload — but only if materials, fuel breeding and reliability are all solved together.
